steps.title: Analyze Build Output
steps.description: Examine the Gradle compile log to find the root cause of the build failure.

steps.title: Locate Duplicated Layout Elements
steps.description: Trace the duplicate id 'etPosDiscount' in activity_erp.xml.

steps.title: Remove Redundant Discount EditText
steps.description: Edit activity_erp.xml to remove the duplicate etPosDiscount EditText layout node to resolve compiler ambiguity.

steps.title: Adjust Horizontal Layout Margins
steps.description: Align the remaining Discount and Tax Rate inputs in the horizontal layout block.

steps.title: Validate Resource ID References
steps.description: Ensure no other duplicate elements or missing ID definitions exist in resources.

steps.title: Review Java View Inflation
steps.description: Verify ERPActivity.java safely binds etPosDiscount and etPosTaxRate without runtime inflation clashes.

steps.title: Check App Assets Manifest
steps.description: Ensure the updated app-meta.json matches ERP package credentials.

steps.title: Run Lint Verification
steps.description: Pre-validate the static resource structure locally before initiating full compilation.

steps.title: Prepare Assembly Pipeline
steps.description: Initialize the final Gradle compilation process and clean previous residual builds.

steps.title: Building OmniFlow Business ERP
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to finalize the build pipeline.
